notes.title: Update Information (210506)
notes.content:
An update has been released.
--------------------------------

[i]Note: This only applies to Windows and Linux/Steam OS users[/i]

-Voice desync which occurred when switching languages is now fixed. Further desync when using rollback after switching languages is also fixed.
-There is a high possibility that your previous save files will cause the game to crash. In some cases, selecting 'Rollback' a few times may break out of the crash and allows you to re-save. For users that don't want to use the new update, the previous build can be accessed by right-clicking 'Fatal Twelve' in your Steam Library, selecting Properties, and under Betas, select 'old_build'.
-As always, users may need to delete the [i]persistent[/i] files in case achievements suddenly stop working.

[b]Additional Update:[/b]
There was an issue where suddenly certain background images were not appearing correctly. The issue has been fixed just now so please update your game in Steam if you haven't done so already.

notes.title: Update on Chinese Language Localization
notes.content:
Just a heads up for everyone but the Chinese language localization for Fatal Twelve is nearly finished. The majority of the text has been translated with only UI related text left to be translated. Once that's done, the scripts will be sent to the developer to integrate into the build. At that point a build will be sent to QA for some testing before we push the update to all users.

We appreciate everyone's patience regarding this update. Stay tuned for more information as we get it.
